  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MANIPAL INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY - BENGALURU  
  SEVENTH SEMESTER B.TECH. DEGREE EXAMINATIONS - NOVEMBER 2025  
  Extended Reality Technologies [NPT_4135]  
  Marks: 50                                                                              Duration: 180 mins.  
  PART-A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  1)           What is the key difference between kinematics and dynamics in physical modeling?  
  (2)  
  A)  
  B)      Write one major challenge in creating a Multiuser Virtual Environment (e.g., latency,  
  consistency).                                                                            (3)  
  
  C)      Explain the concept of Level of Detail (LOD) as a model management technique. Why  
  is it used, and how does it improve rendering performance?                               (5)  
  
  2)           List out the primary function of a "Digital Twin" in an industrial XR context?  
  (2)  
  A)  
  B)      Why is optimization particularly crucial for VR/AR experiences compared to traditional  
  desktop games?                                                                         (3)  
  
  C)      Explain the difference between low-poly and high-poly models. In which situations  
  would you choose each?                                                                   (5)  
  
  3)           What is the role of HRTF (Head-Related Transfer Function) in creating spatial audio?  
  (2)  
  A)  
  B)      Illustrate the fundamental difference between a 3D Model and a Texture.                  (3)  
  C)      Compare and contrast writing code in C# for Unity versus using Blueprints for Unreal  
  Engine. Outline one advantage and one disadvantage of each visual scripting approach     (5)  
  for designers and programmers.  
  
  4)           Identify the primary cause of Simulator Sickness in VR users?  
  (2)  
  A)

  B)           How does a "Lighthouse" tracking system differ from a traditional infrared tracking  
  system that uses cameras?                                                                  (3)  
  
  C)           Explain the problem of "drift" in IMU-based tracking and describe how a typical VR  
  system compensates for it using a technique like sensor fusion.                            (5)  
  
  5)                What does the term "Six Degrees of Freedom (6DoF)" mean?  
  (2)  
  A)  
  B)           Explain the role of Three-Dimensional (3D) Sound in enhancing presence in a virtual  
  environment.                                                                               (3)  
  
  C)           Explain the term "Perception Engineering" and illustrate how it integrates engineering,  
  human physiology, and perception in the design of VR systems                               (5)
